body.label: Effect
body.html: Wrap yourself or one ally within 4 units in an elemental mantle. Until your next turn, the target gains +1 Defense and resistance to Cold damage.

surges.html: After this resolves, gain +1 Defense until your next turn as the entity partially overlays you.
Choose one additional ally within 2 units of the first; it gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

rider.title: ELEMENTAL — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Elemental.
